svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One blank, folded: front 181 x 206 mm in the middle; a side 106 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wide on each long edge; a top 76 mm deep on the top edge (the 30 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: vent slot at the back is simply the top being short); 10 mm tabs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the ends of the top; a 12 mm flange on the back of each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut with snips; drill 3 mm relief holes where bend lines cross.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the sides back 90 degrees, then the top, then the tabs down over

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the sides; rivet each tab with two 3.2 mm rivets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold each flange 90 degrees inward; drill two 4.5 mm holes 6 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the fold, 30 and 170 mm up from the lower edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flanges flat on the plate, 3 mm beside the box; four M4 thumb

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws into the plate. 15 mm air gap on the front, sides and top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: To open the lid: undo the four thumb screws, pull the shield forward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the gap is 15 mm (plus or minus 2) all round.
